scenes.purpose: Introduce the topic of electric circuits.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To provide a clear title and introduction to the lesson.
scenes.teacher_script: In this lesson, we will learn how to build a simple electric circuit and understand its main components.

scenes.purpose: Explain the main components of a simple electric circuit.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To visually represent the components of an electric circuit.
scenes.teacher_script: A simple electric circuit consists of the following main components: a power source (like a battery), wires, a switch, and a load (like a bulb).

scenes.purpose: Describe how to build a simple electric circuit step-by-step.
scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To illustrate the step-by-step process of building the circuit.
scenes.teacher_script: Let's build a simple electric circuit step-by-step: 1. Connect one wire to the positive terminal of the battery. 2. Connect the other end of this wire to one terminal of the bulb. 3. Connect another wire from the other terminal of the bulb to one terminal of the switch. 4. Finally, connect a wire from the other terminal of the switch back to the negative terminal of the battery.

scenes.template_selection_reasoning: To highlight the significance of understanding electric circuits.
scenes.teacher_script: Understanding electric circuits is important because they are used in many devices we use every day. They help us learn about electricity and how it powers our world.
